content.short: VILVI connects musicians with fans and investors to build their career and income using NFT technology.
content.description: VILVI is a unique platform for distributing music based physical music media and digital NFTs, with a marketplace for fans and collectors to buy and resell their work. We work with artists, labels and distributors to generate extra revenue from unique sales that work alongside the existing physical media and digital streaming economies.
